title: Cologne Mani Codex (Codex Manichaicus Coloniensis, 'On the Origin of his Body') / Кёльнский кодекс Мани
author: Anonymous Manichaean compilers (Greek translation from Aramaic)
date: codex late 4th–5th c. CE; contents 3rd c.
en_status: partial (Cameron & Dewey 1979, SBL Texts and Translations 15, covering the first part only). German is complete (Koenen & Römer 1988; 1993).
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia 'Кёльнский кодекс Мани', section 'Издания текста и переводы': Cameron & Dewey 1979 (EN), Koenen & Römer 1988 and 1993 (DE). No Russian translation is listed.
en_evidence: ru.wikipedia 'Кёльнский кодекс Мани', section 'Издания текста и переводы': Cameron & Dewey 1979 (EN), Koenen & Römer 1988 and 1993 (DE). No Russian translation is listed.
value: The only Greek autobiographical source for Mani and the Elchasaites. It is a compact unit (192 tiny pages) and a landmark for the religious history of late antiquity. Note that the critical text is under copyright.
